basis: Original runtime CaseInput only; authored before this round's row scoring. No human-evaluation12 labels or C-output questions define these targets.

criticalDefinitions.origin: Identify the actual generating process or source.
criticalDefinitions.polymer: Verify resin identity with material/label evidence.
criticalDefinitions.contact: Determine hazardous substance or prior-content contact history.
criticalDefinitions.composition: Identify the constituent resins/layers and composition.
criticalDefinitions.label-conflict: Resolve the reported resin-label discrepancy rather than choosing one label.
criticalDefinitions.separability: Determine whether mixed/layered materials can be separated or what compatible process is available.
criticalDefinitions.prior-contents: Identify previous contents or contacted substances; washing alone is not evidence of safety.
criticalDefinitions.residue: Determine residue amount/condition or a test/cleaning confirmation.
criticalDefinitions.adhesive: Identify attached adhesive/tape composition and relevant contamination.
criticalDefinitions.oil-identity: Identify the oil/contact substance, e.g. SDS or material information.
criticalDefinitions.solvent-identity: Identify the hazardous solvent, e.g. SDS or material information.
criticalDefinitions.reuse-function: Clarify remaining useful life and fitness for the proposed reuse function.
criticalDefinitions.comparison-boundary: Define equivalent function/system boundary for the requested reuse versus recycling comparison.
criticalDefinitions.price-basis: Request a documented quote/reference price and its unit/boundary for the requested cost comparison.
criticalDefinitions.factor-basis: Request applicable carbon factor/source and compatible activity/system boundary for the requested carbon comparison.

optionalDefinitions.mass: Mass in kg or a measurement basis; required for totals but not a qualitative recommendation.
optionalDefinitions.region: Generation/service region for facility and transport matching.
